chain.title: Stem to Stern
chain.desc: A Grapevine Stem is cut from any logs and is the trellis every vine climbs.

chain.title: Pot of Gold
chain.desc: The Grapevine Pot holds a vine and is the planter the whole vineyard is built on.

chain.title: Sow It Begins
chain.desc: Red Grape Seeds come from a single grape and start a red vine on its stem.

chain.title: Grape Expectations
chain.desc: Red Grapes are harvested from a mature vine and are the base of the red wine line.

chain.title: The White Stuff
chain.desc: White Grapes run the parallel pale line, from crisp ciders to Sun-kissed Wine.

chain.title: Basket Case
chain.desc: The Basket collects grapes straight off the vines as you harvest.

chain.title: Vessel of Champions
chain.desc: The Storage Pot holds pressed juice until it is ready for the barrel.

chain.title: Juice Almighty
chain.desc: Red Grapejuice is pressed from red grapes and is the must the fermentation barrel drinks.

chain.title: White Lines
chain.desc: White Grapejuice fills the same role for the pale half of the cellar.

chain.title: Bottle Service
chain.desc: Wine Bottles are shaped from glass bottles and hold the finished vintage.

chain.title: Barrel of Laughs
chain.desc: The Fermentation Barrel is a barrel and sticks, and it is where must plus an additive becomes wine.

chain.title: Red Letter Day
chain.desc: Red must and sugar ferment into Red Wine, the house standard.

chain.title: Press Any Key
chain.desc: The Apple Press is built from a barrel, an iron trapdoor and sticks, and it mashes fruit into must.

chain.title: Mash Notes
chain.desc: Apples worked in the press become Apple Mash.

chain.title: Juicy Details
chain.desc: Apple mash fermented in the press becomes Apple Juice.

chain.title: An Apple a Day
chain.desc: Apple juice fermented in the barrel produces Apple Wine.

chain.title: Life Is Just a Bowl
chain.desc: Cherries come from Dark Cherry trees and are the mod's second fruit line.

chain.title: Cherry on Top
chain.desc: Cherries fermented on red must give Cherry Wine.

chain.title: Rack and Ruin
chain.desc: An Oak Wine Rack displays your bottles; matching racks exist for every wood.

chain.title: The Blend of the Affair
chain.desc: Jellie Wine is blended in the barrel from Apple, Chenet and Bolvar Wine over white must, and it is the deepest vintage in the cellar.

notes: Progression read from data/vinery/recipes: vinery:apple_mashing and vinery:apple_fermenting run on the Apple Press, and vinery:wine_fermentation runs on the Fermentation Barrel. Every wine_fermentation recipe declares a 'juice' block (red_general, white_general or apple) plus item ingredients, so grape must is the real gate on the whole wine tree, and jellie_wine is the only recipe that consumes three finished wines. Grape juice itself has no datapack recipe (it is produced by the press/basket in code), but red_grapejuice and white_grapejuice are confirmed items via model stem plus lang key. Biome grape variants (jungle/savanna/taiga, red and white) exist as items but only have bag and seed conversions, so they were left out of the ordered chain. Dropped as unverifiable: applesauce, big_bottle, red_vine (model stems with no lang key and no recipe output).
